description: Puts shared Windows PCs in Shared PC mode with Entra accounts only: profiles of users who have not signed in for 30 days, or when free disk space drops below 25%, are removed, there is no local storage outside the profile and maintenance runs at 02:00. Baseline assignment: none by default — belongs on SG-D-UEM-WIN-SharedPC. Source: Own baseline — Intune Shared multi-user device (sharedPCConfiguration, SharedPC CSP). OpenIntuneBaseline deliberately does not cover shared devices (WINDOWS/README.md)..
